notes.title: New Release! 『The Princess' Heart』
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.roseportalgames.com/files/pics/newsletter/newsletter_tph_01.png[/img]
Hey everyone! Aaron here!
Exciting news: [b]『The Princess' Heart』[/b] has been released on Steam today!

This brand new fantasy adventure is just a single click away. ★
 Visit the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/378830]Steam store[/url] or click on the trailer below. 

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/378830][img]http://www.roseportalgames.com/files/pics/newsletter/newsletter_tph_02.png[/img][/url] 

[i]With a style inspired by Earthbound and Final Fantasy 3, The Princess' Heart features up to 15 hours of epic fantasy gameplay. Follow Princess Aerin on a quest to defeat her demons, both literal and metaphorical, in this light-hearted tale of hope and love.[/i]

[b]Features—[/b] 
  ★ Spells have an Area of Effect, so you must choose your target wisely! 
  ★ 8 unique playable characters! 
  ★ Up to 15 hours of gameplay! 
  ★ Open exploration of the entire world. 
  ★ A beautiful soundtrack of sweeping melodies and exciting battle tracks. 
★ Customize your characters' spells and skills. 

Just $4.99 and 10% launch discount! Grab it now[b]～[/b]!!

notes.title: New Update & Prequel Release!
notes.notes:
Hey there! Today we've launched the highly anticipated update for Sweet Lily Dreams that includes changes suggested by you -- the fans. 

[h1]Prequel Release: [u][b]Whisper of a Rose[/b][/u][/h1]
We're also very excited to announce that in a mere week -- on [b]November the 14th[/b], we are releasing the game's prequel here on Steam: Whisper of a Rose! Everyone who already owns Sweet Lily Dreams is eligible for a discount with purchasing this new game. More details will be posted soon!

[img]http://www.majhost.com/gallery/starmies4/WhisperOfARose/fbcover5a.png[/img]

Here are all the changes implemented in Sweet Lily Dreams' update:

- Overall decrease of difficulty by 10% (excluding 'Hard' difficulty).
- Decreased enemy's overall agility & evasion by 20%.
- 'Blind' state wears off 80% after 2 turns, instead of the previous 50%.
- All allies have 20% more resistance to 'Blind' and 'Freeze'.
- Sequence breaking London Mansion fixed.
- Banshee's Mass Freeze moved from 4th to the 5th turn.
- Lily now has state protection based on her current dress (e.g. Blind resistance while wearing Thunder dress).
- Fixed a case where having more than the maximum allowed elemental furniture energy would cancel the bonus.
- Added 10 Fire, Water, Thunder and Cold Shards in chests to the Asurean Ruins to allow for early magic scroll crafting.
- "Cyberphobius" from the Hypercubex level now has a 50% chance to Defend instead of using Blind.
- Alt+Enter, Alt+Tab and Alt+F4 enabled.
- German document updated.

notes.title: Update of June the 2nd Online Now!
notes.notes:
The game has received a small update, including the following changes:

- If your username contains a special character (e.g. "é") the game will still be able to run by placing your savefiles in a different location.
- An easy "Set to WASD Controls" feature has been added to the Options menu.
- A "Reset Controls" feature has been added to the Options menu.
- Certain enemies have received different statistics.
- Muggles' "Provoke" skill has been adjusted.
